blocks.text: DC circuit ka basic element (bunyadi hissa) resistor R hai, jo current ya voltage ko control karta hai; in ka relation (taluq) Ohm's law (V = IR) deta hai. AC circuit ke basic elements teen hain: resistor R, inductor L aur capacitor C. Yahi circuit mein current aur voltage ko control karte hain. In elements wale AC circuits agle topics mein hain: resistor (17.5), inductor (17.6, 17.7), capacitor (17.8), phir impedance (17.9) aur in ke combinations (milap) (17.10 se 17.13).

blocks.prompt: AC circuits ke teen basic elements (bunyadi hisse) kaun se hain?

items: AC: resistor R, inductor L aur capacitor C.
